name: antigravity-maestro
description: Sign in with multiple Google accounts and run Antigravity's models (Gemini 3.x, Claude 4.6, GPT-OSS) in Copilot Chat, Claude Code and Codex. See per-account quotas, switch accounts, and rotate automatically when limits run out.

antigravityMaestro.gateway.port.description: Preferred port for the local gateway that Claude Code and Codex talk to. If it is busy, the next free port is used instead. The gateway only binds to 127.0.0.1.

antigravityMaestro.gateway.autoStart.description: Start the local gateway automatically when VS Code launches.

antigravityMaestro.quota.autoRefreshMinu.description: How often to refresh account quotas in the background. Set to 0 to disable automatic refresh.

antigravityMaestro.rotation.strategy.description: How to pick an account when the active one is rate limited or out of quota.
enumDescriptions: Never switch automatically — requests fail with the upstream error
Move to the next eligible account in order
Pick the eligible account with the most remaining quota for the requested model

antigravityMaestro.rotation.cooldownMinu.description: Fallback cooldown applied to an account after a rate limit, when the upstream does not report a reset time.

antigravityMaestro.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time to wait for an upstream response before timing out.

antigravityMaestro.upstreamProxyUrl.description: Optional HTTP(S) proxy URL used for all Google API traffic (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890). Leave empty to connect directly.

antigravityMaestro.oauth.clientId.description: Override the built-in Google OAuth client ID used for sign-in. Leave empty to use the default Antigravity client.

antigravityMaestro.oauth.clientSecret.description: Override the built-in Google OAuth client secret. Only used together with antigravityMaestro.oauth.clientId.

antigravityMaestro.claudeCode.settingsSc.description: Where to write Claude Code environment settings: 'user' (~/.claude/settings.json) or 'project' (.claude/settings.local.json in the current workspace).

antigravityMaestro.claudeCode.smallFastM.description: Model ID used for Claude Code background/haiku-class tasks. Leave empty to reuse the main model.

antigravityMaestro.codex.configPath.description: Path to the Codex config.toml. Leave empty for the default ~/.codex/config.toml.

antigravityMaestro.reloadOnModelChange.description: Claude Code and Codex read their wiring once, when the window starts, so a model change only lands after a reload.
enumDescriptions: Offer a Reload Window button after applying or restoring a model
Say what changed and leave the reload to you

antigravityMaestro.logLevel.description: Minimum log level for the Antigravity Maestro output channel.
